description: Returns a list of written questions

answered.description: Written questions that have been answered, unanswered or either.

answeredWhenFrom.description: Written questions answered on or after the date specified. Date format yyyy-mm-dd

answeredWhenTo.description: Written questions answered on or before the date specified. Date format yyyy-mm-dd

answeringBodies.description: Written questions / statements relating to the answering bodies with the IDs specified

answeringMemberId.description: Written questions answered by member with member ID specified

askingMemberId.description: Written questions asked by member with member ID specified

correctedWhenFrom.description: Written questions corrected on or after the date specified. Date format yyyy-mm-dd

correctedWhenTo.description: Written questions corrected on or before the date specified. Date format yyyy-mm-dd

dateForAnswerWhenFrom.description: Written questions DateForAnswer on or after the date specified format yyyy-mm-dd

dateForAnswerWhenTo.description: Written questions DateForAnswer on or before the date specified format yyyy-mm-dd

expandMember.description: Expand the details of Members in the results

house.description: Written questions / statements relating to the House specified

includeWithdrawn.description: Include written questions that have been withdrawn

members.description: Written questions / statements relating to the members with the IDs specified

questionStatus.description: Written questions with the status specified

searchTerm.description: Written questions / statements containing the search term specified, searches item content

sessionStatus.description: The Session status for which the Questions data will be returned

skip.description: Number of records to skip, default is 0

tabledWhenFrom.description: Written questions tabled on or after the date specified. Date format yyyy-mm-dd

tabledWhenTo.description: Written questions tabled on or before the date specified. Date format yyyy-mm-dd

take.description: Number of records to take, default is 20

uIN.description: Written questions / statements with the uin specified
